title: Toponymia Europaea Attestation Record
description: A single historical name attestation from a primary source. Used for batch imports and validation.

place_id.description: Stable place identifier (Wikidata QID, source-specific ID, or internal UUID)

form.description: Exact attested name form as written in the source (Unicode NFC-normalized)

normalized.description: Normalized lowercase form for matching and deduplication

language_code.description: ISO 639-3 language code of the attested form (e.g., 'non' for Old Norse, 'ang' for Old English)

year_from.description: Earliest year of attestation (CE; negative for BCE)

year_to.description: Latest year of attestation if date range (CE; null = point date)

source.description: Citation string for the attestation (e.g., 'DN I 23, 1234' or 'Rygh NG XII p. 45')

source_id.description: Reference to source entry in sources.jsonl

source_page.description: Page, folio, or entry reference within the source

context.description: Surrounding text, reason for naming, or historical context

phonetic.description: IPA or phonetic transcription of the attested form

confidence.description: Confidence in the reading/transcription (0.0 = uncertain, 1.0 = certain)

is_current.description: Whether this form is currently in use

lemma.description: Canonical lemma form extracted from this attestation (e.g., 'heim', 'berg', 'by')

lemma_language.description: ISO 639-3 language code of the lemma if different from attestation

components.description: Morphological decomposition of the name form

position.description: Zero-based position in the name (left to right)

language_code.description: Language code if different from parent attestation

collector.description: Person or system that created this record

collection_method.description: How this attestation was obtained from the source

notes.description: Free-text notes about this attestation (anomalies, editorial remarks)

examples.context: Latinized form of ON Bjarmaland, possibly referring to Perm region
